messages:
matt.eng: kicking off staged rollout v1.2.0 -> 5% global now. deploy id=23f9a. change window 10:00-11:00 PDT. watching latency, errors, and KV/cache churn. pinging oncall for stop/go in ~12m. release notes: https://redwood/release/v1.2.0

dev-deploy-bot: rollout started — id=23f9a; target=5% global; started_at=2025-09-14T17:00:00Z

zara.oncall: seeing a small uptick in 5xx on eu-west (0.15% -> 0.8%). CPU looks steady, p50/p95 fine. investigating logs now.

oliver.sre: could be KV cache warmup/churn. getting repeated evictions in eu-west: `kvcache: evict shard=23 count=412`

qa-lee: quick note — I repro a markdown-list formatting regression on a tiny sample (0.02%): bullets collapse into a single paragraph when requests include trailing spaces. repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"- item1 \n- item2 \n"}'`

julie.product: thanks — does that change the customer-facing release notes? small UX diff but may surprise docs-heavy users.

matt.eng: thanks all. plan: keep global 5% for now but split/pin regionally. pin eu-west to previous stable (v1.1.9) while we warm KV and investigate formatting repro. execute pin now for eu-west, continue 5% elsewhere.

dev-deploy-bot: route update requested by matt.eng — region=eu-west action=pin revision=v1.1.9 status=success at=2025-09-14T17:03:12Z

dev-deploy-bot: rollout id=23f9a remains 5% global with revision=v1.2.0 (non-eu traffic)

zara.oncall: confirmed — eu-west 5xx dropped back to baseline after pin. continuing to monitor for 10m.

oliver.sre: recommend a follow-up: run a KV warmup job and a small localized bake in eu-west before unpinning. command to run for ops: `redwoodctl warmup --region eu-west --shards 50`

matt.eng: filing followup ticket and adding note to release: "eu-west pinned to v1.1.9 due to KV-cache warmup causing transient 5xx; reattempt unpin after warmup and QA."

julie.product: will update release notes and internal comms with the eu-west caveat, and add a line to customer-facing changelog about minor markdown rendering tweak.

qa-lee: i'll run targeted tests for the markdown repro against v1.2.0 in non-eu env and report back in an hour.

matt.eng: consensus: continue staged rollout outside eu (non-eu stays at 5%), eu-west pinned. if anyone sees regressions in the next 15m call stop. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

oliver.sre: +1 — will watch infra metrics and post any anomalies here.

zara.oncall: posting short telemetry snapshot to the ticket and will add logs if anything pops up.

matt.eng: closing the thread — followups: ticket #INF-4821 (kv warmup + eu bake), PR#998 to update release notes, and a QA run scheduled.
